topic: government emergency alert texts on every phone
title: In Korea, the Government Texts Every Phone at Once

slides.kicker: EVERY PHONE IN THE ROOM GOES OFF.
slides.headline: In Korea, the government **texts every phone** at once.
It's called **jaenan munja**
slides.body: 재난문자, a disaster text. It goes out to every phone near a cell tower, so a tourist gets it too.

slides.headline: Three levels, **three sounds**
slides.body: A plain safety notice, an emergency alert, and the top level for air raids and war. Each one is louder than the last.

slides.headline: The top one **can't be turned off**
slides.body: You can mute the lower two in settings. The top level always rings, even on silent.

slides.headline: Not just earthquakes. **Everything.**
slides.body: Heat waves, cold snaps, heavy rain, bad air, wildfires. In 2024, even trash balloons from North Korea.

slides.headline: Missing people, **too**
slides.body: Since 2021, a text goes out when a child or an older person with dementia goes missing, with a photo link.

slides.headline: Elsewhere a rare alarm. **Here, a weekly buzz.**
slides.body: Many countries save phone alerts for the worst days. In Korea it's part of the weather.

slides.headline: The morning Seoul was told **to get ready to evacuate**
slides.body: May 31, 2023, after a North Korean rocket launch. The national government called it a mistake 22 minutes later.

slides.headline: In Korea, the warning **finds you.**
slides.body: One text, every phone, wherever you're standing.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: City street at dusk with glowing phone screens, softly blurred behind the text.

caption:
In Korea, the government can send one text to every phone in an area at once, called jaenan munja.

Heat waves, heavy rain, missing people, and the top level rings even on silent.

Does your phone ever get alerts like this?
reply: One more: it works through cell broadcast, not your phone number, so nobody needs your contact details and you can't unsubscribe from the top level. Visitors with a roaming or local SIM get the same texts, mostly in Korean. How do emergency warnings reach people where you live?
fact_check: 2장: 재난문자는 셀 방송(CBS) 방식, 기지국 범위 안 모든 휴대폰 수신 — 전화번호 등록 불필요. 외국인·여행자도 국내 망 접속 시 수신.
3장: 재난문자 3단계 — 안전안내문자(일반 알림음), 긴급재난문자(40dB 이상), 위급재난문자(60dB 이상, 공습경보·경계경보 등). 행정안전부 재난문자 방송 기준 재확인 필요.
4장: 안전안내문자·긴급재난문자는 휴대폰 설정에서 수신 거부 가능, 위급재난문자는 수신 거부 불가.
5장: 폭염·한파·호우·미세먼지(비상저감조치)·산불 안전안내문자. 2024년 5~6월 북한 오물풍선 관련 안전안내문자 발송(서울·경기 등).
6장: 실종경보 문자 2021년 6월 시행(실종아동등의 보호 및 지원에 관한 법률 개정) — 아동·치매환자 등, 경찰청 발송, 인상착의·사진 링크.
8장: 2023-05-31 06:41 서울시 경계경보 위급재난문자('대피할 준비'), 북한 우주발사체 발사 관련, 07:03 행정안전부 '오발령' 정정 문자 — 22분.
댓글: CBS 방식이라 개인정보 불필요. 위급재난문자 수신 거부 불가. 영문 병기 여부는 단계·지자체마다 달라 'mostly in Korean'으로만 표기.
